pre_launch_remediation.note: All items below were found and fixed BEFORE the round/run specs were frozen and before any Qlib compute; no attempt was consumed and no registered hypothesis, parameter, gate, split or DCA rail changed.
findings: raw shard-month filter sliced off only '.gz', so the end month compared as '<YYYY-MM>.jsonl' and the last 11 days (2026-09-01..2026-09-11) were silently dropped -> month now taken up to the first dot, plus a fail-closed 'registered window not fully covered' guard in load_rows; regression tests added

zero-volume 5m bars (20/symbol on 2022-05-01 UTC) were rejected by a strict >0 test -> price fields stay strictly positive, volume may be exactly 0 (legitimate no-trade interval); disclosed in the round-spec data block
tau units: threshold compared a percent-denominated delta against a fraction-denominated grid (100x looser than the source) -> tau_pct is now the source percent grid [0.0, 0.5, ..., 3.5]
walk-forward training window included the day-t feature row (day-t close leaked as a training target) -> train rows now cover days 2..t-1 only (train_n = t-2)
official funding settlements were charged once per bar iterated (up to 288x per episode) -> each settlement is now charged only inside its own timestamped bar
source execution-delay test was implemented as multi-day signal persistence -> replaced by delayed entry prices on the 5m grid, matching the registered next-bar rule
Qlib dump_bin stores float32, so the read-back gate was tightened from an impossible 1e-9 absolute match to exact float32 round-trip with a relative 1e-6 fallback (same gate as the sibling runner)
